name: Zaahen
notes: Opening: Grim Deliverance (R) is cast at t=0 since it is already off cooldown; its shockwave lands after the 0.5 s cast plus the 0.6 s slam delay. Its cooldown (80-110 s) never comes back up inside a 15 s fight, so it casts exactly once.

The Darkin Glaive (Q) is cast to arm the empowered attack as soon as it is off cooldown. When the armed attack lands, its ability-side bonus (base + bonus-AD ratio) is dealt on top of the engine's own normal attack damage: per the bin's ZaahenQ#InitialDamage formula (base + bonus-AD ratio only, no separate 100% AD term), the wiki's stated '+100% AD' is read as the underlying basic attack's own AD damage riding along, not an additional ability term, so it is not added again here.

The recast is always taken: 1.5 s after the first empowered attack lands the next attack is auto-armed for the knockup bonus damage, and Q's real cooldown (post-effect) starts only once that attack lands, or once the 4 s recast window expires unused, whichever comes first.

Only the first cast's double-strike is stated to be able to critically strike; that crit note is approximated by marking its ability-side bonus damage as crit-eligible under the engine's expected-value crit model. The recast's bonus damage, Dreaded Return, Aureate Rush and Grim Deliverance are not stated to crit and are not marked crit-eligible.

Dreaded Return (W) is cast on cooldown; both damage passes (initial and max-range) are assumed to land on the dummy, applied together right when the 0.5 s cast completes since no separate travel time is given for the second pass.

Aureate Rush (E) is cast on cooldown, dashing so the dummy is caught on the outer 'sweet spot' edge of the flourish for the increased physical damage plus the bonus %-max-health magic damage, per the proposed rotation; damage lands after the dash's travel time (350 / 900 units-per-second, from the sheet).

Determination (P): every landed attack or ability hit on the dummy adds a stack (capped at 12); because the rotation keeps hitting the dummy well inside the 5 s fall-off window throughout the fight, stacks are assumed never to decay and this is not modeled. The bonus AD it grants (a level-scaling percent of Zaahen's other bonus AD, doubled at 12 stacks) is recomputed at every hit and added both to Zaahen's attack damage and to every bonus-AD-ratio ability term.

Dreaded Return's cooldown uses ddragon's live values (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) rather than the wiki text (14 to 12s) or the game-file bin note (16/15/14/13/12s) quoted in the dossier, since these three disagree and ddragon is Riot's own current data.

Grim Deliverance's permanent percent armor-penetration passive is not modeled: the engine exposes no percent-armor-penetration hook to drivers (only the target-debuff shred slot and the sheet's own flat lethality), and it only affects mitigation, not the pre-mitigation amounts dealt here.
Healing (Q's self-heal, R's heal-per-champion) and the passive's resurrection are ignored: healing and survival mechanics do not matter in this fight.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here plausibly binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: the bin's exact per-level interpolation formula (ZaahenPassive#PercentBonusADCalc) is unresolved; the wiki's stated linear interpolation from 1.5% at level 1 to 2.8% at level 18 is used instead
assume Aureate Rush lands on the outer 'sweet spot' edge against the stationary dummy for maximum damage, per the proposed rotation
Dreaded Return's missile travel time to its second (max-range) pass has no stated data value, so both damage instances are applied together right after the 0.5s cast completes
Determination's stack decay/fall-off timing is not modeled; the rotation's frequent attacks and casts are assumed to keep it refreshed within its 5s window for the whole fight
